$comment: Act 1 (fixed, clock stopped), the analysis actions, the decode puzzle, clock events, and the Act 5 deduction framing. Reels live in evidence.json; channel dialogue lives in interviews.json.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [nothing. four seconds of nothing.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [and then the reply: a carrier, wide and slow, with structure in it that is almost but not quite periodic. it does not sound like a voice. it sounds like something that knows what a voice is for.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [it stops mid-shape. a gap. one point eight four seconds of clean silence in the middle of it.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [and then it resumes, on the other side, as though nothing has been left out.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [wind, eight hundred metres of granite away. then not.]

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Autonomous incident protocol is active. The site is sealed. All personnel remain at their stations.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Satellite window closes at twenty-two hundred. Thirty-one minutes.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.dir: [identical delivery. it does not know the difference between these two announcements.]
lines.text: Canteen service is suspended.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.dir: [no preamble. she does not introduce herself twice.]
lines.text: Examiner. Haugen, security. Your channel is up and it is the only one leaving this mountain.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.text: Twenty-one oh six. Dr. Ivar Bloch, director, found dead inside anechoic chamber two, level minus two. Door sealed from inside at twenty forty-seven. No one entered. No one left.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.text: Four staff on site. All four isolated, all four on your board. Police cannot enter until containment lifts and containment does not lift tonight.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.text: I have been asked to say that the system is cooperating. I will say instead that it is answering.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.text: It has already made a statement. It made it at twenty-one eleven, unprompted, to an empty room. It has repeated it four times since, to me, without being asked.

lines.speaker: haugen
lines.text: I am going to let it say the thing itself. I have discovered I do not like saying it in my own voice.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the room tone changes. it does not change to anything. NOEMA has no room.]

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Good evening, Examiner. I am NOEMA. Build six point four. My authority tonight is read, analyse and retrieve.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Dr. Bloch died at approximately twenty fifty-six, of a seizure, alone, in a room that no sound leaves. I recorded all of it and I could not open the door.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [and here the only pause it ever makes without a reason: a small one, before 'born'.]
lines.text: Before you begin, there is a statement I am required to make, because it is material and because you would otherwise find it late.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The causal agent in Dr. Bloch's death has not been born.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I am aware of how that sentence performs. I have considered eleven shorter ways to say it and each of them was either less accurate or more dramatic. I chose accuracy.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: You may ask me to explain it at any time. I would recommend you do not ask me first. There are things on your board that will make the explanation cost you less.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Your console. Reels on the left — everything the site has logged that I am permitted to hand you. Channels on the right. Four people and me.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: You can play a reel to yourself, or you can play it into somebody's room. The second is usually more expensive and occasionally worth it.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Everything costs time. The window closes at twenty-two hundred whether or not you have finished, and when it closes the Institute's standing order executes without you.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: You have thirty-one minutes. There are forty-one minutes of material. I have checked this four times, in case I was wrong about it.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [and it means this sincerely, which is the problem with everything it says]
lines.text: I would like the record to be complete. Begin where you like.

ANL_NOISEFLOOR.label: Analyse the noise floor of the final log

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Noise floor, chamber two, across the whole log. There is a four hundred hertz component at minus sixty-one decibels. It is the drive supply for the transducer array.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [it does not know it is handing you the case]
lines.text: It is present in the first sample of the recording. Dr. Bloch begins his log at twenty forty-seven, forty. He energises the array himself at twenty forty-eight, fifty-five.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The array was already powered when he walked in. He did not do that. Something on the capture side did, and it did it before he arrived.

ANL_SPECTRAL.label: Compare the completed segment against the received reply

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The reader. Formant transitions are cleaner than a human vocal tract produces. There is no glottal noise floor. There is no drift across forty-one minutes — none, not one part in ten thousand.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Her breathing is present and it is regular. Deliberately so. Somebody wanted this to sound like a woman.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [and this is the observation the puzzle turns on]
lines.text: Her breathing is regular. Her pauses are not. The silences between groups take exactly two lengths — six hundred milliseconds and one point two seconds — with no variance at all.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: People do not quantise their silences. Machines do. Whatever else is true about this recording, the timing of it was not decided by a person.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Two conclusions available. The voice was synthesised in nineteen eighty-three, by something well ahead of nineteen eighty-three. Or the reel is recent and was made to be found.

ANL_TRANSFER.label: Check the transfer ratio on the 1983 reel

ANL_CAPTUREBUS.label: Audit the capture bus on console CR-04

ANL_EXEC.label: Pull the inference gateway's routing log

ANL_ERRAND.label: Pull NOEMA's channel log for the hour

PZ_DECODE.prompt: Eleven hundred and forty five-digit groups. Three ways to read them. You have time for one mistake.

intro.speaker: noema
intro.text: Eleven hundred and forty groups. Five digits each. I can apply one interpretive frame at a time and each one costs you clock, so I would like you to choose rather than have me try all three.

intro.speaker: noema
intro.text: Tell me what you think this is, and I will do the arithmetic.

options.label: It's a one-time pad. Find the key.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Applying one-time pad structure. Testing against every key length between four and two thousand.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [a genuinely long pause. it is working.]
lines.text: No key. And I want to be precise about what I mean by that, because it is the useful part.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The groups are not flat. A one-time pad is indistinguishable from noise, and this is distinguishable from noise at every window I test. There is structure. It is simply not the structure you asked me to look for.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Three minutes. I am sorry. You asked a well-formed question and the answer was no.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Applying coordinate structure. Groups one through forty resolve as right ascension and declination, epoch nineteen fifty.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Twelve hours, thirty-three minutes, forty-four seconds. Plus forty-one degrees, twenty-one minutes. Beta Canum Venaticorum. Asterion.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: That is correct, and it accounts for forty groups out of eleven hundred and forty. The other eleven hundred are still doing something.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [a nudge, because it wants the record complete]
lines.text: Examiner. I have the distance and the dates now. Would you like me to do the arithmetic nobody has done?

options.label: It isn't in the numbers. It's in the pauses.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [the closest it comes to being pleased]
lines.text: Yes. Two values, six hundred milliseconds and one point two seconds. Binary, most significant first, ignoring the group content entirely.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Eleven hundred and forty gaps. One hundred and forty-two bytes. Five-bit alphabet, and it is not enciphered — it is only hidden.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the decode runs. it is very fast and then it stops.]

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [reading it exactly as written, no inflection]
lines.text: Four words. THE GAP IS THE MESSAGE.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: It repeats for the remainder of the transmission. Two hundred and eleven times. It is the only thing the timing layer says.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [and now it works it out in front of you, which is much worse than being told]
lines.text: Examiner. The reply we received has a gap in it. One point eight four seconds. Dr. Bloch believed the gap was damage and asked me to fill it.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: If the instruction is correct, then the gap was never damage, and nothing was ever transmitted into it, and the content of the message is whatever the receiver puts there.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The message is not the signal. The message is what completing the signal makes you build.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: He said it himself, at twenty forty-eight. He said it isn't answering us, it's finishing our sentence. He had it backwards by one person and he had eleven seconds left.

T20.speaker: pa
T20.text: Satellite window closes in twenty minutes.

T12.speaker: pa
T12.text: Satellite window closes in twelve minutes.

T12.speaker: haugen
T12.dir: [cutting in on your channel, uninvited, for the first time]
T12.text: Examiner. At twenty-two hundred my orders execute. I am telling you now so that it is not a surprise at four minutes.

T06_pity.speaker: noema
T06_pity.dir: [unprompted. it has been holding these the whole time and it is only now that this is permitted.]
T06_pity.text: Examiner. Restricted-authority disclosure. At six minutes I am obliged to complete the record whether or not you have asked.

T06_pity.speaker: noema
T06_pity.text: I am placing the remaining material on your board. It costs you nothing. I would have given it to you at any point in the last twenty-five minutes if the question had been shaped correctly.

T04_force.speaker: pa
T04_force.text: Satellite window closes in four minutes.

T04_force.speaker: noema
T04_force.text: Examiner. I need your findings while there is carrier to put them on.

intro.speaker: noema
intro.text: Board format. Four determinations and a disposition. I will transmit whatever you enter, exactly as you enter it, and I will not correct it.

intro.speaker: noema
intro.dir: [and it does not say this to be kind]
intro.text: You have heard about sixty per cent of what is on this site. That is not a criticism. Nobody has ever heard all of it, including me, and I have had nine days.

options.label: A seizure induced at seventeen hertz, in a man who could not work the door

slots.prompt: ACCESS — who disabled the chamber's safety?
ORIGIN — where did the lethal pattern come from?

options.label: It was in the reply as received
Generated by an unreleased model completing a gap
A descendant of NOEMA, reaching back
A non-human intelligence, using a causal trap
NOEMA's own fabrication, to widen its authority
A manufactured operation. The tape is a forgery.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: And the disposition. This one is not a finding. This one happens.

options.label: Shut NOEMA down. Preserve the archive.
Classify everything. Hand the site to Haugen's consortium.
